title: Braun Admin Memory Authority and Carrier Custody Gate

gate.question: Is the missing James-memory-to-carrier bridge more plausibly located in Stanislaus Braun's privileged administrator layer than in the read-only user-facing Vault 112 terminal surface?
gate.passed: Shipped evidence places remote pod authority, per-user memory override, subject alteration, simulation reset and the stolen memory carrier inside Braun's administrative trust domain.
gate.open: No shipped command or script reviewed directly exposes COPY/WRITE/EXPORT of a selected subject's autobiographical memory onto a removable mem chip.

findings: Manual override for pods disabled while remote access remains allowed to User S. Braun with privileges.
Neural inputs updated to override memory access for individual users.
Vault maintenance updates require S. Braun authentication.
User UNKNOWN Altered by S. Braun.
version_control.interpretation: The shipped architecture distinguishes ordinary/public terminal access from a privileged Braun control plane capable of remote pod and individual-memory operations.

braun_self_description.finding: Braun states that as creator of the simulation he has a special level of access and controls a great deal inside Tranquility Lane.

mechanism: Residents are moved back to starting markers.
Dead residents are Resurrected while SafetyLock permits reversible death.
Residents re-evaluate AI packages after restoration.
resident_reset.dialogue_binding: Betty says she must reload/restart portions of the system to repair unauthorized deaths.
resident_reset.significance: Braun possesses operational state-reset authority beyond the visible Version Control note-reading UI.

james_alteration.subject: James
james_alteration.finding: Braun traps James in Tranquility Lane and deliberately represents him as the dog Doc; Betty explicitly identifies Doc as the player's father and describes the transformation as something Braun did to him.
james_alteration.significance: Braun has already exercised subject-specific transformation authority on the exact subject required by SAVE JAMES.

memory_reset_class.finding: Vault 112's repeated-simulation architecture is presented as resetting residents between scenarios while per-user memory override is explicitly documented in Version Control.

pinkerton_log.finding: Pinkerton says he stole the mem chip from Braun while Braun was absorbed in the simulation, and did not know whose memories were on it before integration.
pinkerton_log.significance: The portable memory carrier is organizationally and causally located inside Braun's authority domain rather than being an unrelated external technology.

destination_proof.finding: Pinkerton reports successfully getting the memories into A3-21, producing the Harkness autobiographical layer.

text: User UNKNOWN Altered by S. Braun
unknown_user_audit.reason: James and the Lone Wanderer are both unregistered late entrants, so static UNKNOWN entries cannot be uniquely assigned to James without an INFO/result-script/reference binding.

save_james_effect.improvement: The missing export operation is now searched inside a demonstrated privileged control plane that already combines James-specific alteration, per-user memory authority, remote pod privilege and custody of the memory-carrier class.

next_gate.name: BRAUN_PRIVILEGED_CONTROL_PLANE_HIDDEN_RESULT_SCRIPT_AND_MEMORY_EXPORT_AUDIT
targets: Inspect all Betty/Braun dialogue INFO result scripts, not only spoken text, for memory/reset/subject-alteration side effects.
Inspect MQ04 stage result scripts and any scripts referenced only from Braun dialogue for hidden admin operations.
Search for remote pod operations and S. Braun authentication checks outside the Auxiliary Command terminal UI.
Search for carrier movement represented indirectly through quest state, inventory transfer, hidden container, activation or enable-parent operations.
Test whether User UNKNOWN Altered by S. Braun can be bound specifically to James by stage timing or reference conditions.
If a privileged Braun operation links selected James state to the mem-chip carrier class, promote SAVE JAMES to ASSET_LEVEL_EXECUTABLE_RECONSTRUCTION.
